tool_input.description: Alias legacy variables to tokens in base.css

tool_input.command:
git add -A && git commit -q -m "Install Hardlift 0.1.0-rc.5 tokens and DM Sans

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline | head -2

sed -i 's|<path d="M10 14.5h9M14.5 10v9" stroke={INK}|<path d="M10 14.5h9M14.5 10v9" stroke={ON_PINK}|; s|<path d="M3 12.5h23" stroke={INK}|<path d="M3 12.5h23" stroke={ON_PINK}|; s|<path d="M7.5 18h5" stroke={INK}|<path d="M7.5 18h5" stroke={ON_PINK}|; s|<path d="M104 53H48M64 37L48 53l16 16" fill="none" stroke={INK}|<path d="M104 53H48M64 37L48 53l16 16" fill="none" stroke={ON_PINK}|; s|^const RAISED = .*|&\n/* Glyphs drawn on a pink face stay black in both themes. */\nconst ON_PINK = '"'"'var(--color-text-on-action)'"'"';|' src/components/Sticker.tsx && grep -n "ON_PINK" src/components/Sticker.tsx
tool_input.description: Use on-action ink for glyphs on pink sticker faces

tool_input.command: Remove-Item src/pages/PreviewPage.tsx -Confirm:$false; Copy-Item design-packages/hardlift-0.1.0-rc.5/dist/tokens.css, design-packages/hardlift-0.1.0-rc.5/dist/tokens.json -Destination (New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force design-system); Test-Path AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md
tool_input.description: Delete preview page and copy tokens into design-system
